name: polymarket-bot
description: Polymarket crypto trading platform monorepo (paper-only defaults; no live credentials required).

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --dir test/soak/recorder run typecheck
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/storage-postgres test:integration && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/event-bus test:integration && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/research-worker test:integration && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/data-gateway test:integration && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/trader test:integration
scripts.test:contract: pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/polymarket-public test:contract && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/polymarket-public test:contract:rtds && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/binance-adapter test:contract && pnpm --filter @polymarket-bot/coinbase-adapter test:contract
scripts.test:compose: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose up -d --wait && docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U devlocal -d polymarket_bot_dev && docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli ping && docker compose down
scripts.ops:validate-dataset: cd python && uv run python -m research.compaction
